# Frontend design

Before writing any code, pick a direction and say it in one line:
what it should feel like, and the one thing people will remember.

## Type

- One display face, one text face. Never more than two.
- Set a scale (1.25) and keep to it.

## Colour

- Start from the brand colour; derive the rest.
- Check contrast with scripts/contrast.py.
